name: ClassifyAndLinkEmail
description: Stores Maya's classification of one InboundEmails row: category, linked customer (name and owning bookkeeper taken from the data, never from the caller), mentioned invoice numbers and a short summary. Rules enforced here, not in the prompt: category לא רלוונטי deletes the body, attachments and summary in the same write (bodyStored=false, status לא רלוונטית); a כרטסת or חובות פתוחים request from a sender who is not מאומת creates one CollectionQueue task לאמת שולח (recommendedAction להתקשר, 'לאמת בטלפון') and sets status ממתינה לגורם פנימי. Relevant mail adds an Interactions row (דואל, נכנס) for a linked customer. A פירוט תשלום email is only linked to the customer: IdentifyCustomers' recent-mail rung reads linked mails when it identifies a payer. Idempotent per email. Sends nothing.

customerCode.description: Customer code when Maya linked the email to a customer (from GetCustomer360 / VerifySender)

mentionedInvoiceNumbers.description: Invoice numbers mentioned in the email

agentSummary.description: Short Hebrew summary and analysis. Ignored for לא רלוונטי

verifyTask.description: The לאמת שולח task created or already open, if any

nextStep.description: Hebrew: what Maya should do next (e.g. prepare a statement PDF, or stop: task created)
